Theorem
[the slice theorem]

Source: petersen:page-0226 ↗ def:pet-ch5-slice-representation ↗ thm:pet-ch5-free-slice-theorem 1. ch5:5.6.24Let $H\subset \operatorname {Iso}(M,g)$ be closed. For $p\in M$ there is a map $\exp ^\perp :H\times _{H_p}T_p^\perp Hp\to M$ that is a diffeomorphism on a uniform tubular neighborhood $H\times _{H_p}B(0,\epsilon )$ onto an $\epsilon $-neighborhood of $Hp$.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch5-slice-theorem \sketch By subsection 6.4, the orbit is properly embedded. The equivariant map $(h,v)\mapsto Dh|_p(v)$ descends to $H\times _{H_p}T_p^\perp Hp\cong T^\perp Hp$ because $D(hk^{-1})Dk(v)=Dh(v)$ for $k\in H_p$. The tubular construction in subsection 6.4 then gives a uniform $H$-invariant embedding on $H\times _{H_p}B(0,\epsilon )$.

□
